The '''Ubskai''' were a clan of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] who ran the [[Reclamation Services, Inc.]] recycling operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. [[Ukert]] was a clan member.
